examples.hook: Your forecast is 30% wrong and your CRM is why.
examples.caption: Most teams forecast off stage names that mean nothing. Define exit criteria per stage, enforce them, and your forecast tightens inside a quarter. We've seen accuracy jump from 61% to 88%.

gold_posts.topic: The vanity metric killing your board deck
gold_posts.hook: Total pipeline value is the metric that gets CROs fired.
gold_posts.caption: A $40M pipeline means nothing if 70% is stuck past its sell-by date. Report weighted, time-decayed pipeline instead and your board stops celebrating fiction. Takes one view in your CRM to fix.
